verdict: WSUS MMC console crashes browsing updates. The per-user MMC application cache is corrupt, typically after an unclean WSUS cumulative update install.
fix: Close the WSUS console. Delete `%appdata%\Microsoft\MMC\wsus.msc` for the affected user. Reopen the console; the cache rebuilds on first use. If multiple administrators are affected, push the delete via a per-user scheduled task or document the workaround in the admin runbook.
